_purpose: Canonical deployed-SQL lock. Records the identity of SQL functions that carry money or consent semantics, so drift between a database and the reviewed artifacts in supabase/sql-artifacts/ is detectable. Read-only counterpart to supabase/functions/FUNCTION-LOCK.json. Update ONLY in the same reviewed commit that changes the corresponding artifact, with the new hash in the commit message.
_convention: raw_sha256 = encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(oid),'UTF8')),'hex') with NO post-processing. This is the ONLY enforced value. Historical hashes recorded under _notes are informational and MUST NOT be used as pins.
_scope: Initial coverage is the two artifacts landed in R-2. Extend deliberately; every entry added must have a matching artifact file.
_runbook: supabase/sql-artifacts/README-SQL-LOCK.txt — usage, safety, how to add an entry, and the negative-test method. Kept as .txt because the repo .gitignore has a repo-wide *.md rule.
_verifier: scripts/verify-sql-lock.sh — READ-ONLY. Exit 0 = all match, exit 1 = BLOCKED.

functions._notes: Ticket D public receipt handler. Byte-identical on staging zpqkhbhhgxaiallqvigr and production exayifxbqduhsxmmsnxr as of 2026-09-02.
